description: This file defines the HousekeeperTask class, representing various housekeeping tasks in the Thingsboard project, including task creation methods and a description generator.

classes.name: HousekeeperTask
classes.description: Represents a housekeeping task with various static factory methods for creating specific task types, and a method to generate a description.

methods.name: deleteAttributes
methods.description: Creates a HousekeeperTask for deleting attributes of an entity.

methods.name: deleteTelemetry
methods.description: Creates a HousekeeperTask for deleting telemetry data of an entity.

methods.name: deleteEvents
methods.description: Creates a HousekeeperTask for deleting events of an entity.

methods.name: unassignAlarms
methods.description: Creates a HousekeeperTask to unassign alarms for a user.

methods.name: deleteAlarms
methods.description: Creates a HousekeeperTask for deleting alarms of an entity.

methods.name: deleteTenantEntities
methods.description: Creates a HousekeeperTask for deleting tenant entities of a specific type.

methods.name: deleteCalculatedFields
methods.description: Creates a HousekeeperTask for deleting calculated fields of an entity.

methods.name: deleteJobs
methods.description: Creates a HousekeeperTask for deleting jobs related to an entity.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a string description of the task, including task type and entity details.
